name: Cube–Half-interval Product
definition: For integers $m\ge1$ and $n\ge2$, on the disjoint coordinate domain $[m+n]=\{1,\ldots,m+n\}$ define $\mathcal C_{m,n}=\{S\cup\{m+1,\ldots,m+i\}:S\subseteq[m],\ 1\le i\le n\}$. Thus the first $m$ coordinates form a full binary cube, independently of the last $n$ coordinates, whose positive sets are nonempty initial segments.
comments: A finite product family separating prefix-$k$ from repeated $k$-block Littlestone dimension, and strictly separating $k$-block dimension from VC. For asymptotic witnesses, fix $m$ and the block size $k$ while $n$ tends to infinity.
